name: 10 AN to 3/4" NPT Adapter
title: 10 AN to 3/4" NPT Adapter
description:
The 10 AN to 3/4" NPT Adapter is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN to NPT Adapter Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to NPT ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, and power steering plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
